description: Paper-faithful FACE ARAE training profiles. Use smoke for code validation, ladder for Thunder A6000 iteration, paper_scale for final multi-GPU reproduction.

smoke.causal_mlp_note: Closest public-code match to the TreeMeshGPT coordinate head cited by FACE: separate coordinate heads conditioned on previous coordinate embeddings.

ladder_a6000.augmentation_note: Use offline/frozen augmentation for ladder runs. Online SO3/flip/axis-scale augmentation changes FACE ordering every step and is only appropriate after the no-augmentation overfit gate is healthy.
ladder_a6000.causal_mlp_note: Closest public-code match to the TreeMeshGPT coordinate head cited by FACE: separate coordinate heads conditioned on previous coordinate embeddings.

paper_scale.causal_mlp_note: Closest public-code match to the TreeMeshGPT coordinate head cited by FACE: separate coordinate heads conditioned on previous coordinate embeddings.

paper_knob_a100_probe.note: A100 validation gate that restores the paper's bins, point samples, VecSet size, bottleneck, Muon, LR/WD, and online augmentation while keeping the current 512-face strict-target corpus cap. Uses bf16 autocast because A100 paper-scale training is normally mixed precision even when omitted from methods text.

strict_policy.rule: Paper details are defaults for FACE reproduction. Off-paper production changes must be labeled as ablations or sidecars.

offpaper_production_tokens.reason: The paper uses 128 bins, but our Objaverse++ strict-target pilot improved strict token pass rate from 71% at 128 bins to 97% at 512 bins by avoiding quantized edge cracks. Use 128 only for paper-faithful ablations.
offpaper_production_tokens.paper_lane_status: off-paper ablation only; not primary FACE evidence
